1.mascotDialogue: Same idea as before, beta, just ONE more pointer per node. But now — arre — every insert needs FOUR pointers updated, not two! Miss even one, and the list looks perfectly fine walking forward, and a complete mess walking backward.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 9 through 13, beta — that is the four-pointer dance. New node's next, new node's prev, the old neighbor's prev, the target's next. Miss line 11 and — chup-chap, quietly — prev-traversal breaks while next-traversal is still smiling at you like nothing happened.

3.mascotDialogue: Notice — the arrows come in pairs now! Every connection between two nodes, it is really TWO separate pointers, agreeing with each other. Like a good jodi, haan, both sides have to say yes.

4.mascotDialogue: This, beta, is exactly why doubly linked lists cause more trouble than singly ones — forward direction can look absolutely perfect, while backward is quietly, secretly broken the whole time.
